info.title: bifrost
info.description: MCP server and CLI for language servers, code search and tagged file editing, rooted per call rather than per session.

commands.name: edit
commands.description: Apply a patch document, read from stdin. See the `edit` MCP tool for the grammar.

options.name: --mode
options.description: atomic (all patches or none) or independent (apply what works). [Default: @"atomic"]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Validate and show the diff without writing.

options.name: --retry
options.description: Token from a failed or dry-run batch, whose validated patches re-run. [Default: null]

options.name: --report
options.description: auto | diff | summary | none. [Default: @"auto"]

options.name: --context-lines
options.description: Lines of context around each changed region. [Default: 3]

options.name: --cwd
options.description: Directory the section paths resolve against. [Default: null]

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the structured payload instead of the echo. Never elided.

options.name: --path
options.description: Directory to search. Defaults to the working directory. [Default: null]

options.name: --type
options.description: Named type filter instead of a pattern, e.g. 'ts', 'py', 'config'. [Default: null]

options.name: --hidden
options.description: Include hidden files.

options.name: --by-modified
options.description: Sort by last modified. Implies a flat, ungrouped listing.

options.name: --max
options.description: Maximum files to return. [Default: 300]

options.name: --format
options.description: grouped | plain | auto. Auto is grouped on a terminal, plain when piped. [Default: @"auto"]

commands.name: grep
commands.description: Search file contents, or piped input, by regex. Honours .gitignore.

options.name: --path
options.description: Directory or file to search. Omit to read stdin when it is piped. [Default: null]

options.name: --glob
options.description: Filter, e.g. "*.cs" (any depth) or "src/**/*.cs" (path-scoped). [Default: null]

options.name: --type
options.description: Named type filter, e.g. 'cs', 'ts', 'py', 'config'. Combines with glob. [Default: null]

options.name: --fixed-string
options.description: Match the pattern literally instead of as a regex.

options.name: --ignore-case
options.description: Force case-insensitive. Default is smart case.

options.name: --case-sensitive
options.description: Force case-sensitive. Default is smart case.

options.name: --word
options.description: Match whole words only.

options.name: --invert
options.description: Select lines that do NOT match.

options.name: --files-only
options.description: List matching files instead of lines.

options.name: --count
options.description: Print a count of matches per file.

options.name: --context
options.description: Lines of context around each match (0-10). [Default: 0]

options.name: --hidden
options.description: Include hidden files.

options.name: --max-count
options.description: Stop after this many matches per file, as grep -m. [Default: 0]

options.name: --max
options.description: Total matches to return across all files. [Default: 200]

options.name: --format
options.description: grouped | plain | auto. Auto is grouped on a terminal, plain when piped. [Default: @"auto"]

commands.name: lsp
commands.description: Ask a language server about a position: hover, definition, references, and so on.

options.name: --line
options.description: 1-based line number. [Default: null]

options.name: --symbol
options.description: Identifier on that line, e.g. "Push" or "Push#2". Preferred over --character. [Default: null]

options.name: --character
options.description: 1-based column, when a symbol name cannot identify the position. [Default: null]

options.name: --query
options.description: Symbol to search for (workspaceSymbol only). [Default: null]

options.name: --new-only
options.description: Only diagnostics unseen since the last check.

options.name: --project-dir
options.description: Pin the workspace root instead of detecting it. [Default: null]

commands.name: read
commands.description: Read a text file as numbered lines under a 4-hex tag of its bytes.

options.name: --offset
options.description: 1-based line to start at. Omit for the whole file. [Default: null]

options.name: --limit
options.description: How many lines. The tag always covers the whole file, not the window. [Default: null]

commands.name: resolve
commands.description: Show which server and workspace root a file resolves to, without starting anything.

commands.name: servers
commands.description: List the configured language servers and whether each one is installed.

commands.name: write
commands.description: Write a whole file, with content on stdin. Overwriting needs the tag from a read.

options.name: --tag
options.description: Tag from the last read. Required to overwrite, omitted when creating. [Default: null]
